from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    rects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            cells = []
            while q:
                y,x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            if area >= 4 and (r1>r0) and (c1>c0) and len(cells)/area >= 0.5:
                rects.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,color))
    out = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1,color in rects:
        for y in range(r0,r1+1):
            for x in range(c0,c1+1):
                out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-7fbcb0b9.py'; p.write_text(source)
